review.verdict: One of the raid's top healers on almost every boss, on 30 Mana Potions
review.summary: First or second of the 11 healers on Anub'Rekhan, Faerlina, Grobbulus, Thaddius, the Horsemen, Noth and Heigan, with low overheal on most of them. You drank 30 Mana Potions and used 7 Dark Runes to do it, plus 8 Fear Wards. Your death on Kel'Thuzad was a loose Guardian of Icecrown, not you.

good.title: Top healer
good.text: First of 11 healers on Anub'Rekhan (15% of the healing) and the Four Horsemen, second on Faerlina, Grobbulus (18%), Thaddius, Noth and Heigan.

good.text: 30 Mana Potions and 7 Dark Runes over the night. That's what lets you heal at that level.

good.title: Efficient

fix.title: Trash death

fix.title: Overheal on Patchwerk and Heigan

51114.text: Killed by a loose Guardian of Icecrown (12,537) at 2:15. Not on you.

review.verdict: Top damage of the raid on Kel'Thuzad, but a Spirit's Mark took your world buffs on the Horsemen
review.summary: You finished strong: first of all DPS on Kel'Thuzad with a 71, a personal best by 17 points, and third on Gluth. In between, a Mark from the Spirit of Mograine killed you at 1:49 on the Four Horsemen, at the same second as Harrylarry, and your six world buffs went with it. The Blizzard on Sapphiron got you too.

good.title: Kel'Thuzad 71

good.text: On all 15 pulls.

fix.title: Dead to a Spirit's Mark
fix.text: 4,897 from "Mark" by the Spirit of Mograine killed you at 1:49. Mograine was already dead; his spirit keeps marking anyone near it. You lost all six world buffs for Noth, Heigan, Loatheb and Sapphiron.

fix.title: Sapphiron's Blizzard
fix.text: 7,621 Chill over the two pulls, third most, and it killed you on the wipe at 3:42.

51114.text: Top damage of the raid, 71 (personal best).

review.verdict: Main tank on most of Naxxramas, zero deaths, and 202 Sunder Armors
review.summary: You took every boss melee hit on Patchwerk and Heigan and the large majority on Maexxna, Grobbulus, Gluth, Loatheb and Sapphiron, plus the biggest share on Anub'Rekhan and Kel'Thuzad, and you didn't die once in 16 boss pulls. For a tank the parses are a bonus, but Gluth 95, Razuvious 88, Noth 88 and Grobbulus 82 are all well over your own usual on those bosses.

good.title: No deaths
good.text: Not a single death all night, on a night with 16 boss pulls and a Sapphiron wipe. You usually die about once a raid.

good.title: Sunder Armor machine
good.text: 202 Sunder Armors and 28 Demoralizing Shouts over the raid. Every warrior and rogue hits harder because of that.

good.title: Gluth 95
good.text: Your best Gluth ever (equal to your previous best, median 83), while taking 83% of his melee.

good.title: Patchwerk
good.text: 100% of Patchwerk's melee on you and a 66 parse, against a usual 45 there. Seven Greater Stoneshield Potions used over the night.

fix.title: Flask of the Titans on only 5 of 15 pulls
fix.text: You had 4.9 consumable buffs per boss pull against 6.5 for the other tanks, and the gap is mostly the flask. 1,200 extra health matters most on exactly the bosses you main tanked (Patchwerk, Loatheb, Sapphiron).

fix.title: Sapphiron's Blizzard
fix.text: One Chill hit for 3,151. Blizzard roams, so a tank catching one tick happens, but it's damage your healers didn't need on a fight decided by healing.

51108.text: 95 parse while tanking, equals your best.

51119.text: Main tank: 95% of the boss melee over the kill.

review.verdict: Owned a rolling Ignite on Maexxna, died to its threat, and played eleven bosses without a world buff
review.summary: You came in with seven world buffs and kept them for three bosses. On Maexxna you owned the raid's Ignite: from 0:21 it rolled at five stacks for 4,508 every two seconds, kept alive by everyone's fire crits, and in Classic all of that threat lands on the Ignite's owner. At 0:42 she turned on you and two hits later Fengus, Mol'dar, Slip'kik, Rallying Cry, Zandalar, Songflower and Sayge's were gone. From Patchwerk to the Sapphiron wipe you had none of them, and your parses show it: 54 on average against your usual 79. Sapphiron, where you removed more Life Drains than anyone, saves the grade.

good.title: Raid's top decurser on Sapphiron
good.text: 41 Life Drains removed over the two Sapphiron pulls, the most in the raid (the other decursers had a median of 22). The 7 parse is what doing that job costs, and it was worth it.

good.title: Noth's curses
good.text: 5 Curses of the Plaguebringer removed, the most of anyone on Noth.

good.title: Gothik
good.text: 72 parse and the third highest damage in the raid, with Scorch 50 times while you moved between adds.

fix.title: A rolling Ignite is your threat, not just your damage
fix.text: You owned the Ignite: 59.6k of the 92.7k damage credited to you on Maexxna before you died was Ignite, rolling at 4,508 a tick for twenty seconds on the fire mages' crits (Paiyro's and Osinir's included). That's collective damage, but every point of its threat lands on the owner. When your Ignite has been rolling at five stacks for a while, stop casting and get the other fire mages to hold a second so it drops. That death cost you all seven world buffs for the next eleven bosses.

fix.title: Kel'Thuzad: you died to 990 damage
fix.text: At 2:39 a 990 Frostbolt Volley tick killed you. It was the only damage you took in the last ten seconds, and nobody healed you in that time, so you walked around low for over ten seconds without a Healthstone, a potion or a bandage. You were the sixth and last death of the kill.

fix.title: Elixirs missing on three pulls
fix.text: Greater Arcane Elixir, Greater Firepower and Mageblood were up on 12 of 15 boss pulls, and food on 11. Supreme Power (14 of 15) and Zanza (15 of 15) show you know how; the other three bosses you just didn't bother.

51114.text: Died at 2:39 to a 990 Frostbolt tick, no healing in your last 10 seconds.

51116.text: Killed by Maexxna's melee at 0:42, the first death of the kill: threat from the raid's Ignite, which you owned (59.6k of the damage credited to you).

51117.text: 5 curses removed, most in the raid.

51119.text: 41 Life Drains removed, most in the raid.

review.verdict: A Gluth personal best, then Sapphiron killed you twice: Cleave on the wipe, his own swing on the kill
review.summary: Plenty of effort: 17 Mighty Rage Potions, 14 Sapper Charges and 7.1 consumable buffs per pull. Gluth 80 (second in the raid) and the Horsemen 70 were the high points. Sapphiron was the low one. On the wipe his Cleave killed you; on the kill he turned on you for a single swing at 0:28 and you were the first death.

good.title: Gluth 80
good.text: A personal best (78 before) and second highest damage in the raid.

good.title: Consumables and explosives

good.title: Meteor soaks
good.text: 3 Meteors soaked on the Horsemen.

fix.title: Sapphiron threat
fix.text: At 0:28 on the kill Sapphiron swung at you once (6,249) between two hits on his tank, and you died. The boss only does that to whoever is top of his threat table: you passed the tank. Watch threat in the first 30 seconds of a pull.

fix.title: Sapphiron's Cleave
fix.text: On the wipe his Cleave (4,517) killed you at 2:50. Cleave hits what's in front of him; melee stand at his sides.

fix.title: Impale and polarity
fix.text: Two Impales on Anub'Rekhan (5,940, second most) and one Negative Charge hit on Thaddius.

51119.text: First death of the kill: pulled threat at 0:28.

review.verdict: 34 Life Drains, 260 Faerie Fires, 10 Innervates and no deaths
review.summary: A night of jobs done well. On Sapphiron you removed 34 Life Drains, second most in the raid; on Noth 4 curses. You kept Faerie Fire on the bosses all night (260 casts), handed out 10 Innervates and used a Rebirth, and you didn't die once. Your healing share was on the low side on most bosses, which with that much utility is the trade.

good.title: Sapphiron decursing
good.text: 34 Life Drains removed, second most in the raid (median of the decursers: 22).

good.title: Faerie Fire
good.text: 260 Faerie Fires over the night. Every physical hit on the boss benefits.

good.title: Innervate and Rebirth
good.text: 10 Innervates and a Rebirth.

good.title: No deaths
good.text: Zero deaths in 16 boss pulls; your usual is 1.5 a raid.

fix.title: Overhealing on the easy fights
fix.text: 84% overheal on Grobbulus, 86% on Noth and 83% on Razuvious. Fine to let others heal those and spend the globals on Faerie Fire and decursing.

fix.title: Rain of Fire
fix.text: One Rain of Fire tick on Faerlina (2,113).

review.verdict: Two personal bests, a Soulstone and six healthstones, but a slow start in the Spider Wing
review.summary: Your usual 72 on average, but with a real high end: Gluth 98 (best before: 90) and Thaddius 87 (best before: 80), plus the Four Horsemen at 88. The Spider Wing was the weak part: Anub'Rekhan 41 and Maexxna 49, at the bottom of the DPS on both.

good.title: Gluth 98
good.text: A new personal best by eight points.

good.title: Thaddius 87
good.text: Another personal best, with a Nature Protection Potion used.

good.title: Stayed alive
good.text: 6 Major Healthstones and 3 Limited Invulnerability Potions used over the night. Your only death was late in the Sapphiron wipe (25th of 29).

good.title: Consumables
good.text: 6.1 buffs a pull against 5.9 for the other DPS, with Supreme Power, Greater Arcane and Fortitude on every pull.

fix.title: Spider Wing
fix.text: Anub'Rekhan 41 (your usual: 75) and Maexxna 49 (usual: 78): 26th of 26 and 27th of 28 DPS.

fix.title: Avoidable damage
fix.text: Impale hit you for 3,363 on Anub'Rekhan (more than most) and you took a Rain of Fire tick on Faerlina.

review.verdict: The best prepared rogue in the raid, undone by a Shadow Fissure and a lot of standing in things
review.summary: 8.1 consumable buffs per boss pull, 12 Sapper Charges and 17 Dense Dynamite: nobody brought more. But your average (54) was well under your usual 70, and the avoidable damage tells you why: two Impales on Anub'Rekhan, a Void Zone on the Horsemen, and on Kel'Thuzad a Shadow Fissure that made you the first death of the kill.

Thaddius 81 is a personal best (before: 67), and the night was well above your usual on almost every boss even if the average (69) looks lower than your 73. One avoidable death: Sapphiron's Cleave.

At 1:49 on the Four Horsemen, a Mark from Mograine's spirit killed you, the first death of the kill, and you played Noth, Heigan, Loatheb and the Sapphiron wipe with none of those buffs. Add two trash deaths and the Sapphiron wipe and it's four deaths against your usual one.

On the Four Horsemen, though, you stood in Blaumeux's Void Zone for two ticks (7,500) and died at 2:18, and with that went all eight of your world buffs for Noth, Heigan, Loatheb and Sapphiron. review.verdict: Soaked 44 Hateful Strikes on the best consumables in the raid, but died on the first trash pull
review.summary: You switched between tanking and DPS all night: off-tank on Anub'Rekhan, Faerlina, Thaddius, Gothik and the Horsemen, Hateful Strike soaker on Patchwerk, DPS on Maexxna, Grobbulus, Gluth, Heigan, Loatheb and Sapphiron. As DPS you beat your own numbers on Gluth (50, your best before was 38) and tied your best on Grobbulus. Nobody came better prepared: 8 consumable buffs per boss pull, with Flask of the Titans on all 15.

fix.text: On the wipe two Blizzard ticks hit you for 6,110 in your last ten seconds and killed you at 2:55. The pull was already lost by then (you were the 21st of 29 deaths), so it cost little, but that's two ticks of Chill you could have walked out of.

51112.text: The log loses you after 0:11 (no swings, no damage taken). Most likely you were teleported out of the logger's range, so no blame here.

51119.text: Two Chill ticks killed you on the wipe.

review.verdict: A 98 on the Horsemen and 88 or better almost everywhere, but Thaddius never saw you
review.summary: Consistent as usual: an 82 average against your normal 83, with the Four Horsemen at 98 (your best before was 89) and Faerlina 95. You and the other hunters handled Gluth's Frenzy. Two things stand out: the log has nothing from you on Thaddius, and you were the second death of the Sapphiron wipe.

good.title: Four Horsemen 98
good.text: Fourth highest damage in the raid on the Horsemen and a new personal best by nine points.

good.title: Consistent

fix.title: Thaddius: absent from the log

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: 4.6 buffs per pull against 5.9 for the other DPS. Flask of the Titans on 10 of 15 pulls and Zanza on 4; no Juju or Firewater at all.

51119.text: Second to die on the wipe (Life Drain), and died late on the kill to Frost Aura.

51120.text: Nothing from you in the log for the whole fight, 0 DPS.

51121.text: 98, your best Horsemen by nine points.

Your healing share was solid on Faerlina, Razuvious and Sapphiron. On the trash-light bosses most of your Heals landed on people already at full health.

good.title: Kel'Thuzad shackles
good.text: 9 Shackle Undead cast, the most in the raid (the other shacklers had a median of 3). Your low healing there is the price of that job.

good.title: Fear Ward
good.text: 13 Fear Wards over the night.

good.title: Razuvious
good.text: 27% of all healing on Razuvious, the most of the 11 healers.

good.title: Sapphiron
good.text: 746 HPS with only 10% overheal on the kill, 11% of the raid's healing.

fix.title: Overhealing
fix.text: 77 to 88% of your healing was overheal on Anub'Rekhan, Maexxna, Patchwerk, Grobbulus, Noth and Heigan, mostly from Heal. That's casting on people who were topped up before it landed. Cancel the cast when your target is full, or start later.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: Zanza on 3 of 15 pulls and food on 7. Flask of Distilled Wisdom 12 of 15 and Mageblood every pull are good.

51119.text: Died 27th of 29 on the wipe, after it was lost.

review.verdict: Zero deaths, 90+ on seven bosses, and 334 Curses of Recklessness
review.summary: Your best Naxxramas in a while: an 86 average against your usual 72, and you didn't die once on a night where you usually die about twice. Patchwerk 97, Grobbulus 96, Gluth 95 and Kel'Thuzad 95 are all at or near your best, and you did it while keeping Curse of Recklessness up all night.

good.title: Never died
good.text: Zero deaths in 16 boss pulls, including the Sapphiron wipe that killed 29. You average two deaths a raid.

good.title: Curse duty
good.text: 334 Curses of Recklessness over the raid, recast every time Loatheb stripped it (5 on him alone).

good.title: Top-end parses
good.text: Patchwerk 97, Grobbulus 96, Gluth 95, Kel'Thuzad 95, Heigan 94, Noth 91, Razuvious 90. Kel'Thuzad 95 beats your previous best there (94).

good.title: Used your healthstones
good.text: 9 Major Healthstones over the night, mostly on Loatheb, the Horsemen, Sapphiron and Kel'Thuzad. That's why you're alive in every one of them.

fix.title: No food buff
fix.text: Food on 1 of 15 boss pulls. You had 4.7 consumable buffs per pull against 5.9 for the other DPS, and food is the cheapest part of the gap.

fix.title: Sapphiron
fix.text: 61 against your usual 76 there, with 16 seconds without a cast from 4:03. Everything else on the night was at or above your usual.

fix.title: Maexxna gap
fix.text: Nothing from 0:29 until Web Spray stunned everyone at 0:40, 12 seconds of no casts on a 70 second fight.

51115.text: Curse of Recklessness reapplied 5 times after Loatheb stripped it.

review.verdict: Frenzy duty done, but two Frost Aura deaths and almost no consumables
review.summary: You shot Gluth's Frenzy and cleansed a poison on Faerlina, but you died on both Sapphiron pulls, early both times, to Frost Aura alone. You usually never die. With 2.9 consumable buffs per pull against 5.9 for the other DPS, your damage sat near the bottom of the raid on most bosses.

good.title: Gluth Tranquilizing Shots
good.text: 2 Tranquilizing Shots, as many as any hunter.

good.title: Mageblood, Mongoose and food
good.text: On every pull (food 13 of 15). The basics are there.

fix.title: Frost Aura killed you twice
fix.text: 6th death of the wipe at 1:09 and 3rd death of the kill at 2:44, both to Frost Aura with almost no healing on you (250 and 0 in your last ten seconds). Frost Aura is constant damage on everyone, so dying to it first means you had less frost resistance or protection than the rest: one Frost Protection Potion over two pulls against a raid median of two.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: 2.9 buffs per pull against 5.9 for the other DPS: no flask, no Zanza, no Juju or Firewater all night. That gap alone is a big part of being 22nd to 27th in damage on most bosses.

fix.title: Kel'Thuzad
fix.text: Hit by Mana Detonation twice and a Frost Blast. Spread wider from other players.

51119.text: Died early to Frost Aura on both pulls.

review.verdict: Eight personal bests and top damage on four bosses, and five deaths
review.summary: On damage this was your night: first in the raid on Anub'Rekhan, Gluth and Sapphiron, and personal bests on Anub'Rekhan (91), Faerlina, Maexxna, Patchwerk, Grobbulus, Gluth (89), Noth and Heigan. You also tanked a corner of the Horsemen for a 96. But you died five times: twice on the first trash packs, then on Gothik, Sapphiron and Kel'Thuzad.

good.title: Personal bests everywhere
good.text: Anub'Rekhan 91 (before: 81), Faerlina 73 (62), Maexxna 68 (61), Patchwerk 71 (65), Grobbulus 80 (70), Gluth 89 (86), Noth 81 (73), Heigan 66 (59).

good.title: Top of the raid
good.text: Highest damage of all DPS on Anub'Rekhan, Gluth and Sapphiron, and top three on Patchwerk, Grobbulus, Razuvious, Noth and Heigan.

good.title: Horsemen tank
good.text: Tanked on the Four Horsemen with a 96 parse and 3 Meteors soaked.

good.title: Explosives
good.text: 13 Goblin Sapper Charges and 8 Dense Dynamite, plus 9 Mighty Rage Potions.

fix.title: Sapphiron's Blizzard
fix.text: 10,144 damage from Chill over the two pulls, the most in the raid (three ticks), and it killed you at 4:25 on the kill: 6,067 of Chill in your last ten seconds. Move the moment it lands on you.

fix.title: Dying on trash
fix.text: Infectious Skitterers killed you one second into the raid and a Dread Creeper at 0:58. Two deaths before the first boss.

fix.title: Gothik undead side
fix.text: Killed by a Spectral Death Knight at 4:14 (4,588 melee, 2,463 Whirlwind in your last ten seconds), the last death of the kill.

fix.title: Kel'Thuzad
fix.text: A 2,408 Frostbolt killed you at 2:38 with 107 healing in your last ten seconds, so you were already low and didn't use a healthstone or potion.

51107.text: Top damage of the raid, 91 (personal best).

51108.text: Top damage of the raid, 89 (personal best).

51109.text: Killed on the undead side at 4:14.

51119.text: Most Blizzard damage in the raid, and it killed you on the kill.

review.verdict: Top DPS on Noth and Loatheb, zombie duty on Gluth, and four Kel'Thuzad kicks
review.summary: A tank who out-damaged nearly everyone when not tanking: first of all DPS on Noth (84) and Loatheb (79, second in raw damage), second on Heigan, top five on Anub'Rekhan, Patchwerk and Grobbulus. On Thaddius you tanked for a 92, and on Kel'Thuzad you interrupted 4 Frostbolts, the second most. Gluth looks terrible on paper, but the log shows why.

good.title: Gluth zombie duty
good.text: 13 Piercing Howls and an Intercept on Zombie Chow. Your 5 parse there is the job, not a problem.

good.title: Kel'Thuzad Frostbolts
good.text: 4 Frostbolts interrupted, second most in the raid, 8 kicks over the night.

good.title: Top damage
good.text: First of all DPS on Noth and Loatheb, second on Heigan.

good.title: Thaddius tank
good.text: 92 while tanking.

fix.title: Thaddius polarity
fix.text: One Negative Charge hit (1,800): wrong side once after a Polarity Shift.

fix.title: Sapphiron's Blizzard
fix.text: 6,998 Chill over the two pulls, fourth most, including 3,035 in the last ten seconds before you died late in the wipe.

review.verdict: Frenzy duty done, but bottom of the hunters and barely any consumables
review.summary: You did your Tranquilizing Shots on Gluth and kept Hunter's Mark up all night (14 casts), and your average (65) was right on your usual. But you were the lowest hunter on 10 of 15 bosses and near the bottom of all DPS on most, and you came with 2.8 consumable buffs per pull against 5.9 for the other DPS.

good.title: Gluth Tranquilizing Shots
good.text: 2 Tranquilizing Shots, as many as any hunter.

good.title: Hunter's Mark
good.text: 14 Hunter's Marks over the night, the raid's ranged damage buff on the boss.

good.title: Beat your usual on a few
good.text: Grobbulus 75 (best before: 63), Thaddius 66 (60), Kel'Thuzad 76 (69), Heigan 69 and the Horsemen 58 over your usual.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: 2.8 buffs per pull against 5.9 for the other DPS: Flask of the Titans on 2 of 15 pulls, Zanza on 2, no Juju. That is most of the gap to the other hunters.

fix.title: Sapphiron wipe
fix.text: 11th of 29 deaths, at 2:17, to Frost Aura with no healing on you in your last ten seconds. One Frost Protection Potion on the wipe; more frost resistance or a second potion keeps you up longer.

fix.title: Maexxna and Patchwerk
fix.text: Last of the DPS on both (51 and 62).

review.verdict: Noth curses and Life Drains decursed, right on your usual, no world buffs for the first three bosses
review.summary: Your 51 average sits on your usual 50. You did the decursing: 5 Plaguebringer curses on Noth (joint most) and 19 Life Drains on Sapphiron. You came in without world buffs and had six of them from Patchwerk on. Two caveats on the numbers: you owned the rolling Ignite on Grobbulus, Thaddius and Gothik, so your damage there includes the other fire mages' crits, and your only death was Sapphiron's Cleave.

good.title: Noth decursing
good.text: 5 Curses of the Plaguebringer removed, as many as anyone.

good.title: Sapphiron decursing
good.text: 19 Life Drains removed.

good.title: Razuvious 83
good.text: Well over your usual 54 there.

good.title: Consumables
good.text: 6.7 buffs per pull against 5.9: Supreme Power, Greater Arcane, Firepower, Mageblood, Zanza and food on nearly every pull.

fix.title: Sapphiron's Cleave
fix.text: Killed by his Cleave (2,586) at 2:50 on the wipe. Ranged have no reason to be in front of him.

fix.title: Impale
fix.text: 3,584 from Impale on Anub'Rekhan, sixth most.

51111.text: You owned the Ignite (49k): fire mage damage credited to you.

review.verdict: Top damage on Faerlina and Grobbulus with the best consumables in the raid, but a Shadow Fissure
review.summary: Nobody came better prepared: 8 consumable buffs per boss pull, everything on every pull. It paid off on Faerlina and Grobbulus, where you did the most damage in the raid, and on Thaddius and the Horsemen (second). Your average (58) is below your usual, dragged down by Maexxna, Gluth and Sapphiron, and you died standing in a Shadow Fissure on Kel'Thuzad.

good.title: Best prepared DPS
good.text: 8 buffs per boss pull against 5.9 for the other DPS: Titans, Mongoose, Greater Armor, Zanza, Firewater and more on all 15 pulls, and 11 Mighty Rage Potions.

good.title: Top of the raid
good.text: Highest damage of all DPS on Faerlina (84) and Grobbulus (85), second on Thaddius and the Four Horsemen.

good.title: Meteor soaks and a kick
good.text: 3 Meteors soaked on the Horsemen and a Drain Life kicked on Gothik.

fix.title: Shadow Fissure
fix.text: Void Blast killed you at 2:19 on Kel'Thuzad (6,879). The fissure gives you three seconds; move the moment it appears under you.

fix.title: Standing in things
fix.text: Impale twice on Anub'Rekhan (5,073, fifth most), two Blizzard ticks on Sapphiron (6,980) and a Grobbulus cloud. Avoidable damage on four bosses.

fix.title: Sapphiron
fix.text: 17 parse and the second death of the kill, at 2:38, to Frost Aura with no healing on you. One Frost Protection Potion over two pulls, against a raid median of two.

51114.text: Died in a Shadow Fissure at 2:19.
